run_training: run the distributed training loop for a 3D face appearance VAE model with configurable architecture
run_net_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the model to compute texture, vertex, and screen space losses
save_training_images: save predicted and ground truth texture maps and rendered screen images to disk
configure_model_architecture: configure the model architecture as base, res, warp, non, or bilinear VAE variants
validate_model: validate the trained model on a test set and log tensorboard metrics for each loss component
